mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:thread inspection returns two nonempty roots and exact detached replies without changing bytes
outcomes: Exact root and reply IDs, text, parent, frozen detached report and unchanged archive.
gaps: One pinned graph; no authored comments or filtered response API.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:resolving a reply updates its complete existing thread while retaining unrelated root bodies anchors and members through path reopen
outcomes: Reply02 selects root1 and reply2; exact receipt and states, non-extension custody, path reopen and undo restore original members.
gaps: No Word UI verification or extension creation.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:mixed states only change mismatched flags and repeat requests preserve exact archives while single-comment semantics remain unchanged
outcomes: Single-comment edit leaves reply open; complete-thread changes one flag, repeat changes zero with exact archive, then root0 changes separately.
gaps: Final states cover two operations; central binding separately asserts full state immediately after each call.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:nested descendants and out-of-order extension entries resolve to the root and retain parent IDs
outcomes: Nested member3 selects root1; reversed extension entries preserve exact receipt, direct parents and comments-part bytes.
gaps: One three-member synthetic chain; no saved path in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:missing root metadata refuses even if selected reply already has the requested state
outcomes: Missing root commentEx entry throws missing-extension before requested-open no-op; exact archive unchanged.
gaps: One missing metadata variant; no general authoring support.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:invalid arguments unsafe graphs unsupported bodies and protection refuse atomically including no-ops
outcomes: Invalid arguments, malformed graphs, missing extension, protection and unsupported bodies throw without byte changes.
gaps: Additional native variants have no exact compiled case identities; errors are not all code-specific.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:thread inspection retains explicit unsupported findings but mutation does not silently ignore unsupported siblings
outcomes: Two root groups and a frozen nonempty unsupported finding remain visible; mutation throws unsupported unchanged.
gaps: One revision-body sibling; no partial mutation permission.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:injected write or serialization failure restores all flags and retains prior package edits
outcomes: Reached write and serialization hooks throw; all nested flags and prior main-part edit survive rollback byte-for-byte.
gaps: Synchronous injected faults only, not filesystem crash recovery.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:thread updates retain alias namespaces lexical values and UTF8 BOM or UTF16 byte order
outcomes: UTF8 BOM and UTF16 LE/BE reopen with alias namespaces, unrelated flag spelling, resolved descendants and unchanged other parts.
gaps: In-memory serialization/reopen; central wrapper adds path save.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:single-comment edits also retain an existing UTF8 BOM and empty thread inspection returns explicit empty arrays
outcomes: Single-comment edit retains UTF8 BOM; empty-package thread inspection returns exact empty arrays without mutation.
gaps: Adjacent single-comment and empty-input regressions; these do not execute the central nested encoding cases.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:comment source order including descendants before roots remains deterministic without changing thread ownership
outcomes: Reordered body3,2,0,1 gives roots0,1/replies3,2; unchanged inspection bytes, receipt3,2,1 and exact resolved states.
gaps: One reordered graph; no path save in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:batched flag edits preserve every unrelated character with quote entity and missing-flag variants
outcomes: Exact extension XML after three selected flags change; unrelated off spelling retained, entity value replaced and absent done inserted.
gaps: Lexical native variant differs from central encoding input; no exact case identity claim.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:thread operation count bound refuses without returning a truncated result or mutating flags
outcomes: Both operations throw docx-comments-limit for10001 comments and retain exact archive.
gaps: Admission bound only; no timing or allocation guarantee.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-comment-threads.test.ts:existing-extension threads do not activate authored-comment response or root-only resolution profiles
outcomes: All nine authored-comment profiles remain planned; complete catalogue totals asserted.
gaps: Inventory guard only, no inspection or authored-profile execution credit.
